name: Kaiho Izumi
source:
She is the homeroom teacher of the protagonist, a beautiful teacher who is very popular among her students.
Her subject is music. She has an image of being somewhat unapproachable in the school, as she has a cold image that emphasizes her innocent and intellectual side.

Cup size: E~F
